comment: Provenance and the SHA-256 hash of the ORIGINAL trigger table (problem type per slot, educational level and pick), written by tools/import/step_sectors.py (import_all.py) from the program's data segment (extracted/tables/, from tools/analysis/export_json.py), never hand-edited. It holds no original bytes: "sha256" is the hash of the whole table, the "size" bytes at "file_offset" of ONWIN.EXE (DS offset "ds_offset"). godot/tests/test_trigger_table_fidelity.gd checks that TriggerTable.encode() hashes to it. The table bytes themselves are written to the git-ignored tests/fixtures/original/trigger_table.json by the same importer run, for first-difference messages. See docs/port/FIDELITY.md, "Fixtures commit hashes, not bytes".
